userid.description: ID of the user that is the owner of the dashboard.

private.description: Type of dashboard sharing. 0 - public dashboard; 1 - (default) private dashboard.

display_period.description: Default page display period (in seconds). Possible values: 10, 30, 60, 120, 600, 1800, 3600. Default: 30.

auto_start.description: Auto start slideshow. 0 - do not auto start slideshow; 1 - (default) auto start slideshow.

pages.description: Dashboard pages to be created for the dashboard. Dashboard pages will be ordered in the same order as specified.

users.description: Dashboard user shares to be created on the dashboard.

userGroups.description: Dashboard user group shares to be created on the dashboard.

name.description: Dashboard page name. Default: empty string.

display_period.description: Dashboard page display period (in seconds). Possible values: 0, 10, 30, 60, 120, 600, 1800, 3600. Default: 0 (uses default page display period).

x.description: Horizontal position from left side of dashboard. Range 0-71.

y.description: Vertical position from top of dashboard. Range 0-63.

view_mode.description: Widget view mode. 0 - (default) default widget view; 1 - with hidden header.

fields.description: Array of dashboard widget field objects.

type.description: Type of widget field. 0 - Integer; 1 - String; 2 - Host group; 3 - Host; 4 - Item; 5 - Item prototype; 6 - Graph; 7 - Graph prototype; 8 - Map; 9 - Service; 10 - SLA; 11 - User; 12 - Action; 13 - Media type.

name.description: Widget field name, per the Dashboard widget fields documentation.

value.description: Widget field value. Type depends on the field's type property.

permission.description: Type of permission level. 2 - read only; 3 - read-write.
Type of permission level. 2 - read only; 3 - read-write.
